description: BICEP3 is a 550 mm refracting telescope at the South Pole for polarimetry of the cosmic microwave background at 95 GHz, in the BICEP and Keck series.
facility_description: BICEP3 observes from the South Pole.
notes: The 2014 SPIE abstract is the passband statement used here. A later instrument paper, arXiv:2110.00482, was resolved but not used for the band quote. No requested acknowledgement was found. The only reuse terms opened for the article are the arXiv non-exclusive licence, which does not grant further reuse and says to contact the author. That is not a grant to redistribute a separate numeric curve. No magnitude system was recorded.
